original_incident_summary: Shipment SH-4105 is delayed due to the temporary closure of the primary port.
rag_validation_rules_applied:
Any alternative route exceeding 120 hours of total added transit delay must be 
classified as CRITICAL_DELAY.

Cargo exceeding 500 tons and routed through Port-South requires a 
WAREHOUSE_FIT_CHECK.

routes_evaluated.reason: Warehouse and route conditions are acceptable

final_operations_brief: Incident ID: INC-002 - Shipment SH-4105 was rerouted via ROUTE-SOUTH-02 due to the temporary closure of the primary port, PORT-SEATTLE-02, as the alternative route met acceptable warehouse and route conditions, including a normal risk tier and 72% utilization at the target warehouse, WH-SOUTH-303. This decision was driven by the need to minimize delays while ensuring the selected warehouse's operational status and risk tier aligned with company standards.
